name: Financial services
description: General industry vocabulary. Not financial advice, and not a substitute for compliance review.

hasDefinedTerm.name: APR
hasDefinedTerm.description: The yearly cost of borrowing including interest and most fees, expressed as a percentage.

hasDefinedTerm.name: APY
hasDefinedTerm.description: The yearly return on savings including compounding. Distinct from a simple interest rate.

hasDefinedTerm.name: basis point
hasDefinedTerm.description: One hundredth of a percentage point. Fifty basis points is half a percent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: underwriting
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assessing the risk of a loan or policy and deciding the terms on which to accept it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: credit score
hasDefinedTerm.description: A model output summarizing credit risk from a borrower's history.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LTV ratio
hasDefinedTerm.description: The loan amount divided by the value of the asset securing it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: DTI
hasDefinedTerm.description: Monthly debt payments divided by gross monthly income. A common lending threshold.

hasDefinedTerm.name: escrow
hasDefinedTerm.description: Funds held by a third party until the conditions of an agreement are met.

hasDefinedTerm.name: amortization
hasDefinedTerm.description: Paying down a balance through scheduled payments that cover both interest and principal.

hasDefinedTerm.name: refinance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Replacing an existing loan with a new one, usually for different rate or term.

hasDefinedTerm.name: KYC
hasDefinedTerm.description: Regulated identity verification performed before opening an account.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AML
hasDefinedTerm.description: Controls and reporting designed to detect and prevent illicit funds moving through a business.

hasDefinedTerm.name: fiduciary
hasDefinedTerm.description: A party legally obliged to act in another's interest ahead of its own.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AUM
hasDefinedTerm.description: The total market value of assets a firm manages on behalf of clients.

hasDefinedTerm.name: expense ratio
hasDefinedTerm.description: The annual percentage of assets a fund charges to cover its operating costs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: liquidity
hasDefinedTerm.description: How quickly an asset can be converted to cash without materially moving its price.

hasDefinedTerm.name: diversification
hasDefinedTerm.description: Spreading exposure across assets so no single outcome dominates the result.

hasDefinedTerm.name: compliance
hasDefinedTerm.description: The function ensuring a business meets its regulatory and legal obligations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: open banking
hasDefinedTerm.description: Regulated sharing of bank data with third parties through APIs, at the customer's direction.

hasDefinedTerm.name: chargeback
hasDefinedTerm.description: A forced reversal of a card payment initiated by the cardholder's bank.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PCI DSS
hasDefinedTerm.description: The security standard governing how card data is stored, processed, and transmitted.

ctx.expansion: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

hasDefinedTerm.name: embedded finance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Financial products delivered inside a non-financial company's product experience.
